en.title: How to share your DBS result
en.p1: You can use this part of the service to share your result with someone else, like your employer.
en.p2: You will need to tell us who you want to share your result with, we will then generate a one time share code to allow them to view your result.
en.p3: We will also send you an email with:
en.bullet1: instructions on how to share your result
en.bullet2: the last 6 digits of your certificate number
en.bullet3: a link to access your result
en.insetText1: You will need to send the share code and email to the person you want to view your result.
en.p4: The person you share your Online Result with can also download a receipt to prove they have viewed your result.
en.bullet6: your DBS certificate number and date of issue
en.bullet7: if your check is standard or enhanced and the workforce it is for
en.bullet8: if any barred lists were checked
en.bullet9: the date they viewed your online result

cy.title: Sut i rannu canlyniad eich DBS
cy.p1: Gallwch ddefnyddio'r rhan hon o'r gwasanaeth i rannu'ch canlyniad gyda rhywun arall, fel eich cyflogwr.
cy.p2: Bydd angen i chi ddweud wrthym gyda phwy rydych chi am rannu eich canlyniad, yna byddwn ni'n cynhyrchu cod rhannu untro i ganiatáu iddyn nhw weld eich canlyniad.
cy.p3: Byddwn hefyd yn anfon e-bost atoch gyda:
cy.bullet1: cyfarwyddiadau ar sut i rannu eich canlyniad
cy.bullet3: dolen i gael mynediad at eich canlyniad
cy.insetText1: Bydd angen i chi anfon y cod rhannu a'r e-bost at y person rydych chi eisiau iddo weld eich canlyniad.
cy.p4: Gall y person rydych chi'n rhannu eich canlyniad ar-lein ag ef hefyd lawrlwytho derbynneb i brofi eu bod nhw wedi gweld eich canlyniad.
cy.bullet6: rhif eich tystysgrif DBS a'r dyddiad cyhoeddi
cy.bullet7: os yw eich gwiriad yn safonol neu'n fanylach a'r gweithlu y mae ar ei gyfer
cy.bullet9: y dyddiad y gwnaethon nhw weld eich canlyniad ar-lein
